name: Kong API Management
summary: Kong API Management covers an API gateway, a developer portal and usage analytics. The Plus plan is listed from $25 a month plus usage, billed monthly, and includes one million API requests before usage charges apply. Enterprise is priced on request and adds SSO, RBAC, SCIM and audit logging. The pricing page does not name its currency.

facts.text: API Management Plus is listed from $25 a month, plus usage, billed monthly, on the pricing page. It does not name the currency.
Per the pricing page, Plus includes one million API requests a month, charges $20 per additional million, and keeps analytics data for 14 months.
Pricing page: a developer portal is listed on Plus, with a maximum of two portals, and no maximum on Enterprise.
SSO, RBAC, SCIM and audit logging are listed as Enterprise controls on the pricing page.
The rate limiting plugin documentation says it limits how many HTTP requests can be made in a set period, from seconds to years, and that it runs on Kong Gateway.

plans.name: Plus
plans.unit: from, per month, plus usage, billed monthly
plans.notes: One million API requests included each month. Developer portal with a maximum of two portals.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing. Adds SSO, RBAC, SCIM and audit logging, and a developer portal with no maximum.

hiddenCosts: Requests above the one million included on Plus cost $20 per additional million, according to the pricing page.
Each additional developer portal is listed at $200 a month.
The pricing page does not name its currency. The Plus figure is recorded as shown.
